data_quality_rule: A secondary liquidation outage must not mark primary market/OI/funding/multi-TF data unavailable. Report the missing component explicitly.

source_policy.liquidations: MarginPad secondary observed; global archive + venue-specific raw coverage

interpretation_rules: Long positions liquidated = forced sell-side flow; short positions liquidated = forced buy-to-cover flow.
Price up/down plus OI up/down does not identify the side of new positioning by itself.
Positive funding means longs pay shorts; it is not automatically crowded-long evidence unless magnitude is elevated in context.
Negative funding means shorts pay longs; it is not automatically crowded-short evidence unless magnitude is elevated in context.
Basis sign alone is not a directional trigger; use magnitude, change, spot/perp state and structure.
price_change_h1_pct is endpoint-to-endpoint; use h1_path for intrahour sweeps, breakouts and reversals.
multi_tf mechanical hints are inputs, not trade signals; acceptance/retest and regime interpretation remain required.
Global liquidation archive and Hyperliquid OI are different venue scopes; do not normalize one mechanically by the other.
Last-good liquidations are historical context only and never replace current H-1 liquidation flow.

BTC.price_change_h1_definition: snapshot midpoint now vs baseline midpoint ~60m ago; NOT the full intrahour path

h1_path.note: Last ~60 minutes of 1m candles. Use this for path/excursions; do not confuse with snapshot-to-snapshot price_change_h1_pct.

15m.note: Mechanical candle summary only; Radar must still interpret regime, acceptance/retest and context.

1h.note: Mechanical candle summary only; Radar must still interpret regime, acceptance/retest and context.

4h.note: Mechanical candle summary only; Radar must still interpret regime, acceptance/retest and context.

1d.note: Mechanical candle summary only; Radar must still interpret regime, acceptance/retest and context.

liquidations_global_h1.bucket_count_semantics: number of returned archive buckets; NOT minutes of coverage
liquidations_global_h1.scope: secondary observed multi-venue archive; approximately 70%+ documented market coverage, not exhaustive

liquidations_hyperliquid_h1.scope: secondary observed Hyperliquid event stream, not official market-wide REST

global_h1.note: Summed from MarginPad time-bucketed observed liquidation archive for the requested 60-minute window.
